title: senecio auriculatus
intro: Senecio auriculatus, commonly known as Golden Groundsel, is a perennial plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae) that is native to Europe and Western Asia. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect cells from damage. The therapeutic actions of Senecio auriculatus include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and colds, as well as its anti-anxiety and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of Senecio auriculatus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
